title: 皐月賞の後に・勝ちたかった

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite their valiant standoff, neither Sakura Chiyono O nor Yaeno Muteki manage to win the race. Both of them let out impassioned cries of frustration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They realize how painful it is to fail, and just how desperately they wanted to win against their rival in a race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of them sincerely wanted to defeat each other. They both wanted to come in first.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Mejiro Ardan watches from the stands, she burns with eagerness, ready to give it her all in one of the few races she'll ever get to run—the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our next goal is the Japanese Derby—the most important race of all in Sakura Chiyono O's eyes.
